actualQuestion: Mount Fuji lies approximately southwest of which Japanese capital city?
rationale: Japanese capital city identifies Tokyo independently of Mount Fuji direction/location; the historical capital Kyoto adds ambiguity. Removing capital can require the intended geographic knowledge while retaining approximate southwest scope. This newly read second substantive weakness prevents an only-cosmetic STOP after the Duke fix. Fresh contextual evidence and independent exact-version review are required.
